root: ^Welcome to Sky Shooters! The only shooting gallery located in the stratosphere.

^Gameplay is simple. Just grab a gun on that table over there with the LMB. Once you have a gun, you can toggle in and out AIMING with the RMB and FIRE with the LMB. You can only FIRE when you are AIMING.

con: ^Once you start, a bunch of enemies will run out from behind the walls. The goal is to shoot as many of them as possible.
^Level A - Lots of enemies but they move pretty slow for the most part
^Level B - Less enemies but they're much faster
tin: ^When you're ready, grab a weapon and choose a level. Press the button to my LEFT to start Level A and the button to my RIGHT to start Level B.
